```{r setup, results='hide', echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(GXPAinterface)
library(SiteMinderBMS)
library(revealxpress)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

qc_vars_to_keep <- c(
  'QC_EstimatedLibrarySize',
  'QC_DynamicRange',
  'QC_FractionContaminatedReads',
  'QC_FractionHemoglobin',
  'QC_FractionRibosomal',
  'QC_ReadsAligned',
  'QC_Median5to3Bias',
  'QC_FractionIntergenicBases'
) %>% 
  tolower()


```


# Report Parameters

```{r params}
if (is.na(params$xpress_project_id)) {
  stop('params$xpress_project_id can not be missing')
}
if (is.na(params$output_dir_path)) {
  stop('params$output_dir_path can not be missing')
}
params_for_tab <- lapply(params, function(xx) {ifelse(is.null(xx),'NULL',xx)})
dt_tab <- as.list.data.frame(params_for_tab) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = 'params', .name_repair = make.names) %>% 
  rename(value = X)

datatable(dt_tab, 
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = 'Report Parameters',
          options = list(
            autoWidth = TRUE, 
            paging = FALSE,
            searching = FALSE
          ))
```


# Connecting to Xpress Database and Querying project ID `r params$xpress_project_id`

```{r query-xpress, message=FALSE}
 if (SiteMinderBMS::validateCookies(prompt = FALSE) == 1 && !interactive()) {
    stop('Not valid cached SiteMinder cookies.\n',
         'You could save your credentials using: \n',
         'SiteMinderBMS::captureCookies() before running this report')
  } 
 
output_directory <-  params$output_dir_path

rx <- connect(username = SiteMinderBMS::getUserInfo()$User)

xpress_project_id <- params$xpress_project_id

xpress_project_info <- rx$get_projects(xpress_project_id)

if (nrow(xpress_project_info) == 0) {
  stop('No project with xpress_id ', xpress_project_id,' found.')
}

xpress_project_info <- xpress_project_info %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x) | .x %in% c('\"NA\"', ''))))

datatable(xpress_project_info, 
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = 'Project info',
          options = list(
            autoWidth = TRUE, 
            paging = FALSE,
            searching = FALSE
          ))

```

project_versions

## Sample Metadata

```{r samples, message=FALSE}
samples = rx$search_samples(xpress_project_id, 
                            annotation_id = project_annotation)
colnames(samples) <- colnames(samples) %>% tolower()
# Need to hardcode some var names
colnames(samples)[colnames(samples) == 'timepoint'] <- 'Timepoint'
colnames(samples)[colnames(samples) == 'barcode'] <- 'Barcode'

if (!is.null(params$additional_metadata) && 
    file.exists(params$additional_metadata)) {
  print(paste("Additional metadata:", params$additional_metadata))
  add_meta <- read.csv(params$additional_metadata)
  samples <- merge(samples, 
                   add_meta, 
                   by.x = "name", 
                   by.y = colnames(add_meta)[1], 
                   all.x = TRUE)
  print(paste("Num cols metadata:", ncol(samples)))
  print(paste("Num rows metadata:", nrow(samples)))
}

if (!is.null(params$control_list)) {
  control_list <- eval(parse(text = params$control_list))
  print(paste("control_list:", paste(control_list, collapse = ",")))
  print(paste(
    "columns present:", 
    paste(
      names(control_list)[names(control_list) %in% colnames(samples)], 
      collapse = ",")
  ))
  bad_ids <- purrr::imap(control_list, 
                         function(x, idx) {
                           if (any(colnames(samples) == idx)) {
                             samples$name[samples[[idx]] %in% x]
                           }
                         }) %>% 
    unlist()
  print(paste0('Following control IDs removed: ', 
               paste0(bad_ids, collapse = ', ')))
} else {
  bad_ids <- character()
}

good_ids <- setdiff(samples$name, bad_ids)

samples <- samples[samples$name %in% good_ids, ]

# Dropping extra QC_ vars and NA columns

samples <- samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(!contains('QC_'), any_of(qc_vars_to_keep))
for (i in qc_vars_to_keep) {
  if (!any(colnames(samples) == i)) {
    warning(i, ' of the Standard QC definition is missing. Excluding from definition')
    samples[[i]] <- NA
  }
}

samples <- samples %>% 
  mutate(
    passed_standard_qc = ifelse(
      (is.na(samples$qc_estimatedlibrarysize) | qc_estimatedlibrarysize >= 3000000) &
        (is.na(samples$qc_dynamicrange) | qc_dynamicrange > 265) &
        (is.na(samples$qc_fractioncontaminatedreads) | qc_fractioncontaminatedreads <= 0.05) &
        (is.na(samples$qc_fractionhemoglobin) | qc_fractionhemoglobin <= 0.05) &
        (is.na(samples$qc_fractionribosomal) | qc_fractionribosomal <= 0.05),
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x) | .x %in% c('\"NA\"', '')))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(`_id` = name, everything())


# Moving some consistent vars to series file
cols_to_move = as.logical(purrr::map_dbl(
  samples, 
  ~ length(unique(.x))) == 1 & !colnames(samples) %in% 
    c(qc_vars_to_keep, 'passed_standard_qc'))
if (any(cols_to_move)) {
  move_to_series <- samples[ , cols_to_move, drop = FALSE] %>% unique()
  
  samples <- samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(!all_of(colnames(move_to_series)))

} else {
  move_to_series <- data.frame(organism = 'human')
}

datatable(samples, 
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = paste0('Sample Metadata (', length(bad_ids),
                           ' controls removed)'),
          options = list(
            autoWidth = TRUE, 
            paging = TRUE,
            searching = TRUE
          ))

```

Note there are `r sum(samples$passed_standard_qc)` samples that are flagged for
failing standard QC.

Removed missing or NA columns, and moved columns with a single value to the series file.

## Expression Data: TPM

```{r expr-tpm, message=FALSE}
tpm_index <- msets$feature_type == 'genes' &
   grepl('TPM', msets$attribute, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
  !grepl('Estimate', msets$attribute, ignore.case = TRUE)

if (sum(tpm_index) != 1) {
  stop('Could not find proper TPM measurement. ',
       'You may have to tweak the TPM selection code manually')
}

eset_tpm <- rx$search_expression(xpress_project_id, 
                             measurementset = msets[tpm_index,],
                             annotation_id = project_annotation)
expr_tpm <- log2(Biobase::exprs(eset_tpm) + 1)
# subsetting on samples
expr_tpm <- expr_tpm[, match(samples$`_id`, colnames(expr_tpm))]

datatable(expr_tpm[1:10, 1:min(5,ncol(expr_tpm))], 
          rownames = TRUE,
          caption = paste0(
            'Expression Data: "', 
            msets$attribute[tpm_index],
            '" (showing subset; full dataset dim: ',
            nrow(expr_tpm),' rows by ' , 
            ncol(expr_tpm), ' columns)'
          ),
          options = list(
            autoWidth = TRUE, 
            paging = FALSE,
            searching = FALSE
          ))

```

# Switching to Hugo and removing duplicates

```{r to-hugo-and-clean, warning=FALSE}

hugo_na <- which(is.na(feat[['gene_symbol']]))
hugo_blank <- which(feat[['gene_symbol']] == "")
toRemove <- union(hugo_na, hugo_blank)

# linking feat and expr datasets and removing missing black hugo if needed
if (length(toRemove) > 0) {
  feat_sub <- feat[-toRemove,]
  expr_tpm_sub <- expr_tpm[match(feat_sub[['ensembl_gene_id']], 
                                 rownames(expr_tpm)), ][-toRemove, ]
  expr_counts_sub <- expr_counts[match(feat_sub[['ensembl_gene_id']], 
                                       rownames(expr_counts)), ][-toRemove, ]
} else {
  feat_sub <- feat
  expr_tpm_sub <- expr_tpm[match(feat_sub[['ensembl_gene_id']], 
                                 rownames(expr_tpm)), ]
  expr_counts_sub <- expr_counts[match(feat_sub[['ensembl_gene_id']], 
                                       rownames(expr_counts)), ]
}
# Remove hugo duplicates
dup_hugo <- unique(feat_sub[['gene_symbol']][(duplicated(feat_sub[['gene_symbol']]))])
if (length(dup_hugo) > 0) {
  print(paste("Found duplicate symbols, n=", length(dup_hugo)))
  dup_to_drop_list <- lapply(
    X = dup_hugo,
    FUN = function(xx) {
      tmp_expr <- expr_tpm_sub[feat_sub[['gene_symbol']] == xx,]
      tmp_out <- feat_sub[feat_sub[['gene_symbol']] == xx,]
      tmp_out$TPM_mean <- apply(tmp_expr, 1, mean)
      tmp_out$status <- if_else(tmp_out$TPM_mean == max(tmp_out$TPM_mean),
                                'Kept', 'Dropped')
      # Need to account when multiple max (take first one)
      if (sum(tmp_out$TPM_mean == max(tmp_out$TPM_mean)) > 1) {
        tmp_out$status[duplicated(tmp_out$status) & 
                         tmp_out$status == 'Kept'] <- 'Dropped'
      }
      tmp_out
    }
  )
  dup_to_drop <- bind_rows(dup_to_drop_list)
  
  genes_to_drop <- dup_to_drop[['ensembl_gene_id']][dup_to_drop$status == 'Dropped']
  
  feat_sub_hugo <- feat_sub[!rownames(feat_sub) %in% genes_to_drop,]
  expr_tpm_hugo <- expr_tpm_sub[!rownames(expr_tpm_sub) %in% genes_to_drop,]
  expr_counts_hugo <- expr_counts_sub[!rownames(expr_counts_sub) %in% genes_to_drop,]
} else {
  print("No duplicate symbols found")
  feat_sub_hugo <- feat_sub
  expr_tpm_hugo <- expr_tpm_sub
  expr_counts_hugo <- expr_counts_sub
}
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(expr_tpm_hugo)) > 0) {
  stop('Duplicated rownames found')
}
rownames(expr_tpm_hugo) <- feat_sub_hugo[['gene_symbol']]
rownames(expr_counts_hugo) <- feat_sub_hugo[['gene_symbol']]

```

## Making Series File

Moving any variables with identical values in samples to series file

```{r series-files}

colnames(move_to_series)[colnames(move_to_series) == 'species'] <- 'organism'
if (is.null(move_to_series$organism)) {
  move_to_series$organism <- 'human'
}

move_to_series$qc_metrics = "Sequencing quality is assessed in the bulk RNAseq pipeline by a number of QC modules including FastQC, Samtools, Picard, and DupRadarref, and these metrics are loaded into the Xpress database for analysts to identify poor quality samples that should be excluded from further analysis. Using the definition found on the RNA-Seq QC Standards confluence page (https://biodoc.pri.bms.com:8443/display/NWP/RNA-Seq+QC+Standards) I created a passed_standard_qc variable if all available QC measures passed"

move_to_series$xpress_url = 
  paste0("https://report.pri.bms.com/xpress/details/?XpressID=",
         params$xpress_project_id)

move_to_series$ngs360_url = 
  paste0("https://ngs.rdcloud.bms.com/projects/", 
         xpress_project_info$project_name)

sample_levels <- map_dbl(samples %>% 
                      select(!contains('QC_'), -passed_standard_qc), ~ length(unique(.x)))

default_group <-  names(sort(sample_levels, decreasing = FALSE))[1]
default_color <-  names(sort(sample_levels, decreasing = FALSE))[2]
if (sample_levels[[default_color]] > 5) {
  default_color <- default_group
}

series_descript = paste0(imap_chr(as.list(xpress_project_info), 
                                    \(x, idx) paste0(idx, ": ", x)), 
                           collapse = ',  ')
if (!is.null(params$series_descript)) {
  series_descript = paste0(series_descript, 
                           ", Additional Description: ", 
                           params$series_descript)
}

make_series_info_file(
  filename = file.path(params$output_dir_path, 'expr.series_info.csv'),
  series_name = xpress_project_info$display_name,
  series_descript = series_descript,
  default_group = default_group,
  organism = move_to_series$organism,
  expr_units = 'RNAseq log2(TPM + 1)',
  default_color = default_color,
  extra.list = as.list(move_to_series %>% 
                         dplyr::select(-organism))
)

datatable(read.csv(file.path(params$output_dir_path, 'expr.series_info.csv')), 
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = 'Series File',
          filter = 'top', 
          options = list(
            autoWidth = TRUE, 
            paging = FALSE,
            searching = FALSE
          ))


```

## Uploading Files

```{r uploading-files}
# upload all the files
all_files = list.files(params$output_dir_path,
                       full.names = TRUE)
upload_files <- all_files[!grepl('gene_linking_file', all_files)]

# need specific order for uploading
first_files <- c('expr.series_info.csv', 'expr.samples.csv',
                 'expr.expr.txt', 'expr.score_info.csv')
upload_files <- c(
  upload_files[match(first_files, basename(upload_files))],
  upload_files[!basename(upload_files) %in% first_files]
)

# GXPA session ------------------------------------------------------------



user_cookie = login_and_get_user_cookie()

# make a new session
message('Making a new session:')
session_name = paste0('Xpress_', xpress_project_info$xpress_id,'_',
                      format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M"))
new_id = begin_new_session(session_name, user_cookie = user_cookie)

for (f in upload_files) {

  tmp_message <- testthat::capture_message(
    send_file_to_session(session_id = new_id,
                         user_cookie = user_cookie,
                         filename_local = f,
                         file_save_name = basename(f)))
  if (str_detect(tmp_message$message,
                 'Successfully uploaded',
                 negate = TRUE)) {
    stop(f, ' could not be uploaded successfully in session ', session_name)
  }
}
```

## Dry Run and Loading Session (optional)

```{r dry-run}
# dry run
message('Running dry_run():')
dry_run_session(new_id, run_type = 'full')



if (params$load_session) {
  
  message('Loeading series:')
  load_session(new_id, load_type = "upload_new")
  
  max.loops = 10
  done.loading = F
  
  while (!done.loading || max.loops <= 0) {
    Sys.sleep(5)
    max.loops = max.loops - 1
    # Confirming data has been loaded
    all_dat <- get_series_info_from_gxpa()
    
    if (!any(all_dat$name == str_squish(xpress_project_info$display_name))) {
      warning('Could not confirm series was successful, checking again')
    } else {
      done.loading = T
    }
  }
  
  if (!done.loading) {
    warning('WARNING: Could not confirm series was successful')
  } else {
    message('Confirmed series uploaded to GXPA')
  }
  
  datatable(all_dat[all_dat$name ==  str_squish(xpress_project_info$display_name), ], 
            rownames = FALSE,
            caption = 'GXPA Data Description',
            options = list(
              autoWidth = TRUE, 
              paging = FALSE,
              searching = FALSE
            ))
}

```
